overviewParagraphs: Red Mountain Golf Club in Phuket is the most visually extraordinary golf experience in Asia — a course carved from the remnants of a former tin mine, where the iron-rich soil creates a stunning palette of deep reds and burnt oranges against the surrounding jungle green. The canyons, cliffs, and vertical rock faces that frame the holes are not manufactured — they are the raw legacy of decades of mining, reshaped into one of the most memorable 18-hole routes anywhere in the world.

The signature 18th hole — a dramatic par five requiring a carry over a flooded canyon to a tiered green — creates a finishing crescendo that players discuss for years after their round. The course demands courage on multiple occasions, but the risk is always clearly rewarded by elevation, sight lines, and visual theatre that no conventional course can replicate.

Red Mountain is consistently AGS's most requested first-booking on Phuket golf itineraries from discerning clients who have read about it online and want to experience it first-hand. It never disappoints. We build it into every Phuket golf program we design.

curatorBriefHtml: Red Mountain Golf Club (opened 2007 by Jon Morrow and Al Tikkanen in Kathu, 20 minutes from Patong and 35 minutes from Bang Tao) is Phuket’s most dramatic, jaw-dropping roller-coaster golf experience. Carved straight through a former tin mine laced with rust-red sandstone cliffs, flooded quarry lakes, and jungle ravines (Par 72, 7,002 yards), Red Mountain delivers vertical elevation drops unmatched anywhere else in Southern Thailand.

Having played Red Mountain personally, hole after hole demands your camera and your sharpest club selection — culminating in the unforgettable par-3 17th plunging nearly 40 metres straight down from a cliffside tee box to a tiny jungle-framed green below. Play smart irons off blind ridge tees rather than pulling driver everywhere, and compare it against Phuket’s classic icon in Red Mountain vs. Blue Canyon.
Red Mountain is the mandatory headline round on every AGS Phuket itinerary, pairing seamlessly with Blue Canyon, Aquella, and Laguna Golf Phuket.

scorecard.verdict: Carved into the rugged topography of an abandoned Phuket tin mine. Dramatic red cliffs, towering elevation drops, and rainforest corridors create an intoxicating, visually stunning sensory overload.

faqs.q: What makes Red Mountain Golf Club the #1 visual thrill in Phuket?
faqs.a: Built inside a dramatic former tin mine in central Phuket, Red Mountain combines rust-red rock canyons, massive vertical elevation drops (like the plunging cliffside par-3 17th), and emerald jungle fairways into a truly one-of-a-kind rollercoaster layout.

faqs.q: How difficult is Red Mountain for mid-handicap golfers?
faqs.a: It is exhilarating and playable if you play smart position golf: take irons or hybrids off tight cliffside tees, move up to the White/Blue tees, and listen closely to your caddie on severe elevation-adjusted yardages.

faqs.q: How far is Red Mountain from Bang Tao / Laguna Phuket and Patong?
faqs.a: Roughly 20 minutes from Patong, 35–40 minutes from Bang Tao / Banyan Tree Phuket, and 45 minutes from Phuket International Airport (HKT).

faqs.q: When is the best season to play Red Mountain?
faqs.a: November through April is Phuket’s dry Andaman high season, offering bright sunshine and dry hillside lies.
